title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in IdeaBox…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in PowerPack Addons for Elementor (up to version 3.1.4) that allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation. This vulnerability can lead to partial compromise of confidentiality, integrity, and availability of affected systems.
